user: I absolutely avoid using any beauty products that are not cruelty-free and vegan.
assistant:  It's great to hear that you are committed to using only cruelty-free and vegan beauty products. By making this choice, you are taking a stand against animal testing and supporting companies that align with your ethical values.

To ensure that the products you use are truly cruelty-free and vegan, it's important to look for certifications from reputable organizations such as Leaping Bunny, PETA, or Choose Cruelty-Free. These organizations have strict standards and regularly audit companies to ensure that they are not engaging in animal testing.

Additionally, it's important to read the ingredient lists of products carefully to ensure that they do not contain any animal-derived ingredients. Some common animal-derived ingredients to look out for include beeswax, lanolin, carmine, and collagen.

By being a conscious consumer and choosing cruelty-free and vegan beauty products, you are helping to create a more compassionate world for all beings. Keep up the good work!
